propositions: A narrow facade operation `note_rich_emit` must own rich-emission binding mutation while preserving the shallow `all_bindings()` query unchanged for public callers.

The operation must produce identical hash, counter progression, and persisted bytes as the legacy in-place mutation sequence when followed by a single unconditional save, across changed, unchanged, and missing binding cases.

The operation must perform no save of its own on any path (changed, unchanged, or missing), matching the production caller which relies on the pass's later save and BindingStore.save's unconditional write.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal, distinguishable by a None return value matching the legacy sequence behavior.
No production adapter must receive direct write access to repository or lifecycle mutation objects; the operation must be the sole supported mutation seam.
